Temp Text: Rough Overview

A Trainer wants a Pikachu she can use a
Thunder Stone on. She’s offered to trade
you her Heracross in exchange.

The requester says he saw a giant Bunnelby
in an alleyway outside of the wild zones.
Meet the requester at the location.

The requester dropped something precious
in the cemetery, which has now become a
wild zone. Your job is to retrieve the item.

Distan seems to think that attacking from a
distance with long-range moves is the most
stylish strategy. Take him on in a Pokémon
battle to see if he’s right.

The requester says Fairy-type Pokémon are
her favorites. Take her on in battle using your
own favorite Pokémon.

A young girl wants to see the Snake
Pokémon Ekans up close. Catch an Ekans
and show it to her.

A young girl is training hard to become the
strongest Kakuna user. Let her show off her
Kakuna in battle.

You’ve been roped into chaperoning a
grumpy Slurpuff. Take it to Café Soleil and
hang out there until Slurpuff is satisfied.

The requester says she is worried about her
Audino, which is behaving strangely. Maybe
a Pokémon battle will calm Audino down...

Paralysis will slow your Pokémon down,
while poison will gradually drain their HP.
Which is stronger? Find out for yourself!

An old gentleman has invited you to join
what seems to be an event showcasing
Budew. Bring a Budew with you to
participate.

The requester says she wants to make
perfume using Skiddo leaves. What kind of
aroma will this perfume have?

The requester says she now wants to make
perfume using snow from Vanillite. What
aroma will the perfume have this time?

The requester has asked for an Abra to play
tag with. He’s offered to trade you his Riolu
in exchange.

The requester has recently started a courier
business. He says he needs an extra-large
Gogoat in order to haul bigger loads. See if
you can find one for him.

The requester says he needs Pansage,
Pansear, and Panpour to create the perfect
cup of tea. Find all three Pokémon and bring
them to the requester.

You ran into a Goomy out and about at night.
After a moment, someone called out—a
police officer. Seems she’s got some
questions for you...

Galarian Slowpoke apparently look different
compared to Slowpoke from other regions.
Trade your own Slowpoke for the requester’s
Galarian Slowpoke.

Status moves can power up your Pokémon
or hinder the opponent. Two Trainers who
are skilled in using both kinds of status
moves have challenged you to a battle.

Some Pokémon don’t evolve unless you
become very close with them. Battle the
Pokémon that the requester has raised with
tender loving care!

There are moves that reduce damage to your
Pokémon by creating barriers around them.
The requester wants to battle you to show
off strategies centered on these moves.

Litleo’s fire is absolutely essential for this
restaurant’s delicious food. Help Litleo get
fired up for cooking with a battle.

An alpha Weedle is ruining the requester’s
garden by gnawing on all the plants. It keeps
coming back even if it gets chased away, so
try catching it with a Poké Ball instead.

The requester is very proud of the massive
Magikarp he caught. Find a Magikarp even
larger than one with a size classification of
XL to show him there’s always a bigger fish!

Some Rust Syndicate grunts are arguing
about whose Pokémon is the strongest. Help
them come to a conclusion.

Wild Trubbish are gathering at Café
Pokémon-Amie, causing the business to
lose customers! Save the café by taking the
Trubbish somewhere else.

A Delibird is running around as if in a
panic. As it turns out, a wild Garbodor is
menacing it...

It seems a certain apartment building has
become haunted. The requester reports
hearing strange noises from the rooftop and
wants you to go check it out.

Sylveon’s soothing powers should put a stop
to fighting! That’s what the requester thinks,
anyway. Help her bring the nearby squabbles
to a peaceful conclusion.

A researcher who has a fossil restoration
device has given you some money to buy a
fossil. Pick up either a Jaw Fossil or a Sail
Fossil from the Stone Emporium.

The requester wants to open up a Pokémon
salon where Furfrou can have their fur
trimmed. Help her improve her skill by
showing her Scyther a move!

The requester wants to add to her repertoire
of Furfrou styles. Help out by showing her
Scyther another move!

The requester wants to add even more
Furfrou styles to her repertoire. Help out by
showing her Scyther yet another move!

Moves that leave a lingering effect on the
battlefield are commonly known as traps.
Experience their nasty effects for yourself in
a Pokémon battle.

The Courier Colis is a huge fan of the Bird
Pokémon Pidgeot. He’s particularly fond of
the move Fly and wants to share his
enthusiasm with you.

Inspired by Canari, the requester is raising a
whole bunch of Eelektrik. He says he’ll
evolve the strongest one into Eelektross, but
will his plan work out?

The move Focus Energy makes a Pokémon’s
moves more likely to land as critical hits.
Face the requester, who isn’t afraid to use
this frightening move!

Protect and Detect both prevent the user
from taking damage, but apparently there is
a slight difference between the two.

Apparently Sky Battles were a bit of a fad in
Kalos until just a few years ago. Try having
a battle using only Flying-type Pokémon.

The requester claims her Pokémon are
stronger when it’s raining. Have a battle in
the rain so you can witness their might.

The requester says she wants to battle
“artistically.” How can a battle be artistic?
Face her, and maybe you’ll find out...

What happens when you have a Pokémon
hold Leftovers? Have a battle with the hard-
working waitress and see for yourself.

The requester’s Galarian Stunfisk has gone
missing. Head to Wild Zone 11 and look for
a Stunfisk that’s disguised as a Poké Ball.

The requester says she wants to make a
perfume using Inkay ink. What kind of aroma
will an ink-based perfume have?

Some wild Aron have grown tired of eating
the same old scrap metal every day. Maybe
you can find some seasoning that will make
their meals more appealing?

The requester is a taxi driver who’s new
to the job. She wants you to help her get
adjusted by being her first fare.

If a Pokémon flinches, it won’t be able to use
the move it was trying to unleash. Flynn uses
moves that are likely to make opponents
flinch, and he wants to face you in battle.

The move Metronome causes a Pokémon to
use another random move. It could change
the tide of battle...or maybe the Pokémon
will just use Splash. Test your fortunes!

A girl says she has some unusual Pokémon
on her team no one else around has, and
she wants to show them off in battle. What
kind of Pokémon could she have?

Some moves deal damage to the opponent
while also restoring the user’s HP. Battle the
requester to get a glimpse of these moves
in action.

Durstin is a maintenance worker who takes
his job very seriously, but now he’s so thirsty
that nothing seems to be getting done.
Maybe a drink will get him back on track?

The requester is having trouble getting a
Holovator up and running, as apparently
there isn’t enough electric power. Maybe
you can give it a zap?

This worker’s on his break, but he says he’ll
happily get back to work and have the
Holovator up and running right away if
you’ll have a Pokémon battle with him.

A Rust Syndicate grunt has chosen one
particular Holovator as his favorite, for some
reason. Beat him in a battle to get him out
of the way.

A Pokémon has made its home in the ground
under a Holovator, causing it to malfunction.
Unfortunately for the Pokémon, you’ll have
to get it to move...

The alpha Watchog is a menace, staring
down anyone who dares approach with its
glowing red eyes. Defeat it to make the
Holovator safe to approach.

Electric-type Pokémon are having a standoff
right in front of a Holovator. It’d be great if
they could take their shocking disagreement
elsewhere.

Wild Beldum have gathered at a Holovator
for some reason, making it so nobody can
use it even after it was just repaired...

A Holovator seems to have a poor connection
to the power grid. The requester claims that
giving it a good whack will get it working.
Hit it with a Fighting-type physical move.

The requester says he’s going to start a new
business with the help of his Camerupt.
What exactly is he scheming?

Apparently there is a Furfrou League in
Lumiose, complete with Elite Four members
all awaiting challengers. Defeat them to
become the strongest Furfrou Trainer!

The requester, an SBC member who’s
particularly fond of Dragon types, wants to
have a battle with you. Use type matchups to
your advantage.

Ice-type moves have a chance of freezing the
opponent solid. Beware of Glace’s Ice-type
Pokémon as you battle her.

Constance battles using only her favorite
type of Pokémon: Bug types. We’re at our
best when we like what we’re working with,
so face her with your favorite Pokémon too!

Unexceptional, ordinary—these are the traits
of the Normal type. But ordinary doesn’t
mean weak! See for yourself what Normal
types can do.

Ghost-type Pokémon are weak to Ghost-type
moves. The requester wants to have a battle
using only Ghost types to determine who
uses them better.

A Rust Syndicate grunt has challenged you
to a battle. She seems to be particularly
attached to Steel-type Pokémon.

The secret to helping a Honedge feel better
is to have it battle a Pupitar...? How is that
even supposed to work?

Pokémon Center clerks are experts at
healing Pokémon. For this requester, that
apparently extends to having her Pokémon
use healing moves in battle.

What did the woman mean when she
muttered “in 30 seconds”? If you want to
find out, you’ll have to face her in battle.

A Trainer is saying he has the strongest
Pikachu—and he wants to prove it. Battle
him using a single Pikachu against his, and
see whose is mightier!

Alolan Raichu apparently look different from
Raichu of other regions. Trade your own
Raichu for the requester’s Alolan Raichu.

In battle, looks can be deceiving. Battle the
requester and her formidable Pokémon.

The requester says she saw a Shiny Mareep
in Wild Zone 1! Or at least she thinks she
did, but she’s not sure. Help her discover
the truth.

A man is wrapped up in Pokémon webbing
and dangling from a tree. How did he even
end up there? Have your Pokémon use a
move to get him down.

A police officer says that he needs a Shuppet
to help with his investigations. Do your part
in keeping the peace of Lumiose by bringing
him one.

The kids in the school courtyard want you to
teach them all about Mega Evolution. Let the
class begin!

A certain movie director is making a thriller
film. He needs a Carvanha for an important
scene—lend him one so he can complete his
work.

A certain movie director is making a horror
film. He needs a Trevenant for an important
scene—lend him one so he can complete his
work.

A certain movie director is making a kaiju
film. He needs a Tyrantrum for an important
scene—lend him one so he can complete his
work.

Enjoy a relaxing full course of battles at
Restaurant Le Nah. Please note it is
considered poor etiquette to heal your
Pokémon while the course is being served.

Enjoy a satisfying full course of battles at
Restaurant Le Yeah. Please note it is
considered poor etiquette to heal your
Pokémon while the course is being served.

Enjoy an exquisite full course of battles at
Restaurant Le Wow. Please note it is
considered poor etiquette to heal your
Pokémon while the course is being served.

Have an exciting experience with spectacular
Pokémon battles that only Sushi High Roller
can offer! Don’t go healing your Pokémon in
the middle of things, though!

A designer of color contacts wants to see a
Mega Camerupt to get some inspiration.
Mega Evolve a Camerupt during your battle
with her.

A designer of color contacts wants to see a
Mega Sableye to get some inspiration. Mega
Evolve a Sableye during your battle with her.

A designer of color contacts wants to see a
Mega Medicham to get some inspiration.
Mega Evolve a Medicham during your battle
with her.

Le Super-Tournoi de Jacinthe is back and
even better than before! It will be you against
Jacinthe—and ONLY Jacinthe!

A hairstylist wants to expand her hair-color
palette by seeing every color of flower that a
Flabébé might adopt.

A hairstylist wants you to battle all five of her
Floette at once so she can get new ideas for
hair colors.

You discovered a large hole in the Rust
Syndicate office’s garden. Find the true
culprit if you don’t want to take the blame.

It seems that Pumpkaboo come in different
varieties that determine their size. The
requester wants a Jumbo Variety
Pumpkaboo.

Hawlucha gazes over the city, hungering for
an intense battle. Satisfy its desire by facing
it once more.

The requester’s Klefki apparently misplaced
a key. The requester let you know where they
went on the day it happened, so see if you
can hunt down the key based on that info.

Binacle are swarming the requester’s prized
boat, preventing him from taking it out for a
ride. Chase away the Binacle for him.

The requester’s Meditite is apparently having
trouble focusing. Find the legendary yoga
master to see if they can help.

The requester wants you to stop his runaway
Whirlipede. Chase after the Whirlipede and
battle it to get it to stop.

The requester is an artist working on a
painting for a contest. As she was doing
some sketches, however, some brambles
showed up, ruining the scenery.

A Froslass revealed itself and stared intently
at you, as if urging you to follow it.

You’ve been invited to a gathering of people
who send messages into space through their
Starmie. It would be rude to decline, so join
them with a Starmie of your own.

The requester wants a Skarmory feather to
craft a chef’s knife. You should be able to
find a Skarmory feather in Wild Zone 17.

Spritzee’s fragrance changes depending on
what it eats. The requester wants lots of
Berries in order to search for new aromas.

A familiar Trainer and her partner Pancham
seem to be having trouble with a customer.
See if you can help them out.

Find all the Spewpa hiding throughout the
museum. Apparently there are 12 in total.

The requester wants you to help her Numel,
which has been frozen solid. Hit it with a
high-powered Fire-type attack to thaw it out!

Two children are arguing over which fossil to
buy with their pocket money. The girl wants
to buy a Sail Fossil, but her brother seems
intent on getting a Jaw Fossil.

Apparently there is a Mawile that can never
be caught, no matter what kind of Poké Ball
you use or how many you throw at it.

The requester is looking for a place to share
with his Heliolisk. Help him find the perfect
spot based on his exacting conditions.

The requester says his younger sister has
gone missing after following a wild Litwick.
Just as you were about to hear his full story,
you noticed a Litwick staring at you...

The requester wants to make a business out
of having his Clauncher wash away sludge
around Lumiose using Water Gun.
Clauncher, however, seems unenthusiastic.

A wild Chespin has decided to pick a fight
with a taxi cab. The driver can’t move the cab
with Chespin in the way—see if you can help
her out.

You came across a wild Fennekin that seems
lethargic and listless. It apparently refuses to
eat food, and even taking it to a Pokémon
Center did nothing. What else can you do?

A Froakie currently reigns as the fastest to
complete a scaffolding course. Try to beat its
time to show it how fast humans can be.

Josée of the Fist of Justice has requested
that you battle her. She seems to have
something on her mind—an all-out battle
might help clear her head.

A wild Emolga is apparently causing trouble
by stealing things from people. Chase after it
using Roto-Glide and retrieve the requester’s
Berries.

The requester wants to put four Bergmite on
the back of a giant Avalugg for some photos.
You’ll need an extra-large Avalugg for that.

The requester wants you to help him find a
Gengar that has gone missing. Perhaps
Gwynn can help you, since she is very
knowledgeable about Ghost-type Pokémon.

Mable called and asked you to come to the
Pokémon Research Lab. What is she up
to now?

After picking up on some sort of psychic
energy from one of your Mega Stones, Mimi
got up and headed out. Where could Mimi
be off to?

The systems at the old Lysandre Labs have
reactivated, unleashing a dangerous
Pokémon that was once a research subject.
This is an emergency—catch Mewtwo!

The requester has come up with a battle plan
in which he gives his Pokémon Berries to
hold. He seems very confident, but do his
skills measure up?

A girl named Ansha suddenly showed up
with the Pokémon Hoopa and asked you to
help her make a donut. What could be
behind this curious request?

Trevelle once quaked in fear at the sight of
an alpha Pokémon, but now he’s back and
ready for battle himself! Take him on to see
the big ol’ bonds he’s built with his team.

Two of your former trade partners have
joined forces and are seeking the chance
to battle you! Try to seize victory against
their two dauntless Raichu in one battle!

You’ve been entrusted with a letter by a man
you met in hyperspace. He says that it must
be delivered to Académie Étoile’s director...

Horace told you about a strange rumor: A
gravestone in the Dormez Bien Cemetery
moves around night after night under
certain conditions. Go see if it’s true!

A Pokémon called Rotom infiltrates
appliances and electronic devices and
changes into various forms. The requester
will showcase all the forms for you!

Felina says that she’ll let you choose one of
three different-looking Meowth as a special
reward if you can beat her in a battle.

Manny at Café Gallant is looking for a gallant
Pokémon to help out with his work. Help
him get the Indeedee of his dreams.

The requester has a new neighbor, who just
moved to Lumiose from another region.
He’s feeling a bit uneasy dealing with this
stranger, so help play go-between for him.

One of the staff at Restaurant Le Yeah is
planning a special event focused on spicy
dishes. Help make it a rousing success
with Scovillain’s Spicy Extract move!

A passionate Canatic wants to reproduce a
photo of Canari chillin’ on a bench. Help the
fan find the bench to complete her quest!

A game developer named Trian wants to tell
you all about polygons. He hopes to illustrate
the concept in a fun way, if you’ll only agree
to trade Porygon with him.

A Gulpin appeared at Hotel Z out of nowhere,
probably lured in by the delicious smell of all
the donuts. Try feeding it one to satisfy its
hunger!

Do you know which Pokémon is depicted
on utility hole covers in the Rouge District?
Bring the Pokémon you believe to be the
right answer, and show it to the requester.

This unremarkable street needs a name that
will really make people remember it. Put an
end to this trio’s endless debate once and
for all by picking a candidate for them.

Crivain is writing an adventure novel, but
he’s struggling to create characters that
really leap from the page. He wants you and
your Pokémon to serve as his inspiration.

Crivain is writing a romance novel, but he’s
struggling to create characters that really
leap from the page. He wants you and your
Pokémon to serve as his inspiration.

Crivain is writing a mystery novel, but he’s
struggling to create characters that really
leap from the page. He wants you and your
Pokémon to serve as his inspiration.

<U+0010><U+0002>Ƌ<U+0001> has been splitting h<U+0010><U+0003>ᄀÿȂeris time between
helping Jett at Quasartico and working with
Team MZ, and <U+0010><U+0003>ᄀÿ<U+0001>she’s been run ragged. Maybe
<U+0010><U+0003>ᄀÿ<U+0001>she could use a hand from a friend like you.

Lida seems to be feeling a little sad that
she hasn’t made it as a dancer yet, while
other people she knows are achieving their
dreams. Lend her a friendly ear.

Naveen’s family doesn’t approve of his
dream to be a designer, and now he doesn’t
seem interested in repairing his relationship
with them. Can you do anything to help?

You got a call from Corbeau about this new
“special scan” system. Sounds interesting...
Head to Corbeau’s office to hear more.

Korrina has challenged you to a battle using
traditional Tower of Mastery rules—one
Lucario versus one Lucario. Take her on!

You met Marcia, who seems to be searching
far and wide for a Trainer she once battled.
This Trainer apparently uses a Dragalge.
Could they be somewhere in Lumiose?

Vinnie is in a spot of trouble. His young
daughter is begging for a Mimikyu, but that
Pokémon isn’t usually found in the Kalos
region. Help catch one for him.

Canari’s come up with an ultra-hardcore
game: the Defenseless Dodger challenge!
Dodge wild Pokémon’s attacks for as long as
you can—no catching or fighting back!

The requester has returned to Lumiose after
a long time away. He still remembers the fine
coffee he had at Lysandre Café years ago, but
is there a way he could enjoy it once more?

The requester can’t even stand, due to the
pain from his bad back. Will the Pokémon
move Octolock really make it better? Save
this poor fellow from his spinal suffering!

“Welcome to Rêve de Musharna! We offer a
very special service for those plagued with
bad dreams, so stop on by and allow us to
ease you into a restful sleep at once!”

The requester is proud of his Seviper—a rare
catch in Lumiose City. But the Pokémon
